title: Faults
current_gap: Single-motor efficiency and GNSS interruption each cover one event; motor stuck/shutdown, sensor bias/freeze, environment disturbance and the public communication-anomaly scope are not accepted.

atoms.name: motor_fault
atoms.required: Stuck/shutdown/efficiency events on explicit motors with truth and FC feedback reflecting the change and clean reset

atoms.name: sensor_bias_freeze_loss
atoms.required: Bias/freeze/loss per sensor with envelope identity; GNSS signal-loss seam alone is one loss event

atoms.name: environment_disturbance
atoms.required: Owned wind/gust/disturbance source, budget and vehicle response evidence; an actuator-command multiplier is not an environment disturbance

atoms.name: communication_anomaly
atoms.required: Public per-link delay/loss/corruption anomaly scope with distinct results; current barrier/fault semantics cover input loss only

atoms.name: fault_plan_identity
atoms.required: Run/epoch/vehicle-bound fault plans over authoritative tick intervals without retroactive or duplicate injection; GNSS plan proves one seam

atoms.name: fault_recovery_reset
atoms.required: Explicit recovery/reset clearing fault state per event type; GNSS reset-by-new-epoch and SceneClock recoverable path exist, motor reset pending

scope_rule: a fault decision record is not a physical effect; only truth and FC feedback proving the target change count

followups.blocked_by: Approved safety/lost-link and numerical budget per #44; child tickets #105-#108
